description.value:
As a reaction to being damaged by a creature you can see within 60 feet, you hurl a small sabotage charge back at your attacker. The creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 2d10 fire damage, taking half as much on a success.

Cast with a tech slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 1st.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 1
